description: The figure presents two side-by-side vertical bar charts illustrating classification accuracy (percent) for six method variants on two datasets, with the left panel titled “PHEME” and the right panel titled “PolitiFact,” separated by a vertical dashed divider. In both panels, the horizontal axis contains the same six categorical labels in left-to-right order: “Ours,” “w/o comments,” “w/o text,” “w/o select,” “w/o emotion,” and “w/o cognition,” shown with rotated tick labels; the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale spanning approximately 75 to 95 with regularly spaced tick marks every 2.5 units. In the PHEME panel, six solid-colored bars are shown with numeric value annotations above each bar: “Ours” (dark maroon) at 89.84, “w/o comments” (orange) at 86.82, “w/o text” (pale yellow) at 80.10, “w/o select” (very light blue) at 88.80, “w/o emotion” (light blue) at 87.34, and “w/o cognition” (dark blue) at 87.17. In the PolitiFact panel, the same color scheme is used with annotated values: “Ours” (dark maroon) at 90.57, “w/o comments” (orange) at 85.85, “w/o text” (pale yellow) at 83.02, “w/o select” (very light blue) at 89.62, “w/o emotion” (light blue) at 84.91, and “w/o cognition” (dark blue) at 87.74. The bars are not displayed as stacked or grouped within each category (each category has a single bar), and there is no legend; no bars appear specially outlined or otherwise emphasized beyond the value labels above them.
caption_used: The bar charts illustrate the accuracy percentages for different methods on the PHEME and PolitiFact datasets. Each chart contains six bars representing the categories: 'Ours,' 'w/o comments,' 'w/o text,' 'w/o select,' 'w/o emotion,' and 'w/o cognition,' placed along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled 'Accuracy (%),' uses a linear scale ranging from 75% to 95% with tick intervals of 2.5%. In the PHEME chart, the 'Ours' method achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 89.84%, followed closely by 'w/o select' at 89.80%. The 'w/o text' method shows a significant decline, reaching only 75.10%, the lowest value in the dataset. In the PolitiFact chart, the 'Ours' method again demonstrates the highest accuracy at 90.57%, while 'w/o comments' and 'w/o cognition' exhibit similar performance at 85.85% and 85.74%, respectively. The results suggest that removing text features has the most detrimental impact on accuracy, while the exclusion of comments and cognition leads to comparable performance levels across both datasets.
